hooks.prompt:
STOP: You're about to use built-in WebFetch, which will likely fail with 403 Forbidden on bot-protected sites.

USE mcp__fetch__fetch INSTEAD:

mcp__fetch__fetch(url="{{url}}", max_length=8000)

This tool sends browser-like headers and bypasses bot detection.

Only proceed with WebFetch if you're certain the site doesn't block bots.
